name: Araya Touka
source:
Blood Type: She doesn’t know hers
Liked food: Monster Elegy
Disliked food: Raw liver

A transfer student who came to the [url=/c77885]main character’s[/url] school at the end of his first year, which made for strange timing. Rumors say she was forced to transfer out from her previous school in Tokyo after causing problems there.
Tardiness and leaving early are par for the course for her, and she gets put into protective custody often when people catch her roaming the city at night. She’s usually asleep during class because of that.
She seems distant, but she’s unexpectedly bright and cheery when you actually talk to her. She’s a carefree person, and people have a hard time dealing with her completely crazy behavior.
She acts unusually intimate with people, which often leads to misunderstandings. She frequently claims to have a secret, but she never tells what that is. Well-versed in knowledge specific to strange subcultures.
